description.zh:
需要移入云资源实例的资源组ID。

> 资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见[什么是资源管理](~~94475~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the cloud resource instance.

> A resource group is a mechanism for managing resources by group within an Alibaba Cloud account. Resource groups help you address complex resource grouping and authorization management issues within a single cloud account. For more information, see [What is Resource Management?](~~94475~~).

description.zh:
云资源所属的地域ID。


您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the cloud resource.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh: 需要修改资源组的云资源的实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the cloud resource for which you want to modify the resource group.

description.zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：

- **Vpc**：专有网络
- **Eip**：弹性公网IP
- **BandwidthPackage**：共享带宽
- **PrefixList**：前缀列表
- **PublicIpAddressPool**：地址池
- **FlowLog**：流日志
- **HaVip**：高可用虚拟IP
- **TrafficMirrorFilter**：流量镜像筛选条件
- **TrafficMirrorSession**：流量镜像会话
- **IPv4Gateway**：IPv4网关
- **IPv6Gateway**：IPv6网关
- **IPv6Address**：IPv6地址
- **DhcpOptionsSet**：DHCP选项集
- **GatewayEndpoint**：网关终端节点
description.en:
The type of the cloud resource for which you want to modify the resource group. Valid values:

- **Vpc**: virtual private cloud (VPC)
- **Eip**: elastic IP address (EIP)
- **BandwidthPackage**: Internet Shared Bandwidth
- **PrefixList**: prefix list
- **PublicIpAddressPool**: IPAM pool
- **FlowLog**: flow log
- **HaVip**: high-availability (HA) virtual IP address
- **TrafficMirrorFilter**: traffic mirror filter
- **TrafficMirrorSession**: traffic mirror session
- **IPv4Gateway**: IPv4 gateway
- **IPv6Gateway**: IPv6 gateway
- **IPv6Address**: IPv6 address
- **DhcpOptionsSet**: DHCP options set
- **GatewayEndpoint**: gateway endpoint

title.zh: 修改云资源所属的资源组
title.en: Modify the resource group of a cloud resource

descriptions.zh: **ChangeResourceGroup**接口不支持在同一个物理专线实例内并发修改物理专线资源所属的资源组。
descriptions.en: The **ChangeResourceGroup** operation does not support concurrent modifications of the resource group for Express Connect circuit resources within the same Express Connect circuit instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc move-resource-group --resource-id vpc-hp31psbg8ec3023s60000 --resource-type vpc --new-resource-group-id rg-acfm3peow3k0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
